newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan jobless rate at 2.60 percent in December.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan jobless rate at 2.60 percent in December.

text.p: Taiwan's unemployment rate was at 2.60 percent in December, compared with 2.86 percent in November, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting, and Statistics said on Thursday.
The average jobless rate was also 2.60 percent for the year of 1996, the directorate said.
The December jobless rate came in lower than the average 2.86 percent projection that resulted from a January 21 Reuters poll of Taiwan economists.
The number of unemployed people in December decreased 24,000 to 245,000 from November, while the number of employed increased 50,000 to 9.18 million.
The average 2.60 percent jobless rate for 1996 was the highest level since the rate hit 2.66 percent in 1986, the directorate said.
The directorate attributed the high jobless rate in 1996 to a domestic economic slowdown, which increased closures of local businesses.
As for December, more people entered the labour market because of the growth in the manufacturing industry, the directorate said.
Analysts have said they expected the current economic recovery, which started in late 1996, to last through the first quarter of 1997.
